sents.t: After the storm, the heater in my apartment stopped working.
The apartment was freezing, and I could see my breath in the kitchen!
I called Mr. Brooks, my landlord.
“Hi, Mr. Brooks. This is Sam in Apartment 3. My heater is broken.”
“Oh no! I’m sorry, Sam. I have to call a repairman. He can come tomorrow morning.”
That night, Rosa invited me for dinner.
“You shouldn’t sleep in a cold apartment,” she said.
“Take my small heater.” She also told me, “Read your lease. The landlord has to fix the heat. That’s the law here.”
The next morning, the repairman came at eight.
He was a friendly man named Joe.
He checked the heater and changed an old part.
“This heater is twenty years old,” he said.
“You should tell Mr. Brooks to buy a new one.”
In the evening, Mr. Brooks knocked on my door with a box of cookies.
“A new heater is coming next week,” he said.
“And you don’t have to pay rent for three days.”

comp.q: What was wrong in Sam’s apartment?

comp.fa: سام به چه کسی زنگ زد؟

o: The landlord has to fix the heat.
Sam has to buy a heater.

comp.q: What did Mr. Brooks bring in the evening?
